_read: Fireplace's coin, quoted in PROS, to be created on pump.fun's web app. name, symbol, description, image, links and mayhem_mode are WELDED at the create: a wrong one is a second coin. This folder has the shape of Elo Pros' launch kit (scry-forge deploy/pumpfun) and copies over it; there, `node launch.mjs price fireplace.json` reads what the opening buy costs in PROS, and after the create `node launch.mjs coin --mint <coin> --title fireplace` records it. `node tools/coin.mjs` checks this file and draws the pictures; docs/coin.md is the plan and the day. Nothing here has an address yet.
name: Fireplace
description: Fireplace is a free party game on Elo Pros, in your browser: a living room with a fire going and a TV that plays party minigames, an arena, a dogfight and golf in turn, with a whole crowd in one room. FIRE is its coin, paired against PROS. Play signed in and finish the day's challenges for a share of the daily pot. Every house wallet is listed at elopros.com/tokenomics.html
